summary: Autonomous Docker dangling/ephemeral cleanup and stale /tmp test-dir reclamation in fixos auto

delivery.outcome: Enable fixos auto to autonomously reclaim dangling Docker images, dangling build cache, strictly allowlisted 0-ref ephemeral/qualification Docker images, uv/pip caches, and stale (>2h) current-UID /tmp test directories without touching active containers, protected images, Docker volumes, or user data.
nonGoals: Do not modify fixos/cli/fix_cmd.py or tests/unit/test_auto_cleanup.py (reserved by ticket-163).
Do not delete Docker volumes, running/stopped container images, approved/parent/latest images, or user backups/documents.

architecture.decision: Extend the existing hooks already called by fixos auto (_auto_cleanup.cleanup_docker_builder, _auto_cleanup._CACHE_PATHS, _cleanup_space._scan_tmp) plus _cleanup_free_target helpers with fail-closed container-image inspection, strict ephemeral allowlist and protected-token guards, and current-UID 2h retention for known /tmp test prefixes.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-176 PR to restore previous Docker build-cache-only and 24h-only /tmp cleanup behavior.

commands: wellman run --root . --allow-primary-venv -- pytest -q tests/unit/test_auto_remediation.py tests/unit/test_auto_cleanup.py tests/unit/test_cleanup_tmp.py tests/unit/test_cleanup_free_target.py
validation.evidence: All new and existing auto-cleanup, /tmp, and free-target unit tests pass.
GOV-PASS and zero Wellman errors on ticket-176.
